fun_facts: As a senior at Airline, Kenny Darby caught 83 passes for 1,124 yards and eight touchdowns, and added 609 rushing yards and nine rushing touchdowns.
As a junior, Kenny Darby led Louisiana in receiving yards, with 100 catches for 1,764 yards and 24 touchdowns.
Kenny Darby also competed in track and field at Airline.
Kenny Darby set Kentucky’s single-game freshman record with 12 catches for 96 yards and a touchdown against South Carolina.
Kenny Darby finished with 57 catches in the season, breaking Kentucky’s freshman receptions record of 50.

basis.reasoning: The UK Athletics roster gives Darby’s senior and junior statistics and notes his participation in track and field. UK Athletics’ South Carolina game notes record his 12-catch freshman single-game record, and the Missouri postgame notes state that his 57 catches broke Kentucky’s freshman season record.

excerpts:
• Caught 83 passes for 1,124 yards and eight touchdowns as senior for head coach Justin Scogin at Airline  
• Also rushed for 609 yards on 49 carries and nine touchdowns
citations.title: Kenny Darby – UK Athletics

excerpts:
Kentucky wide receiver Kenny Darby and offensive tackle Lance Heard have earned Southeastern Conference weekly honors, the league announced Monday. Darby is the Freshman of the Week and Heard the Offensive Lineman of the Week for performances in a 35-34 overtime victory at South Carolina.

Darby, a 6-foot-1, 180-pounder from Bossier City, Louisiana, was sensational as the Wildcats marked the biggest comeback road win in school history.  The previous record was in 2009 at Georgia, when the Wildcats rallied from a 27-13 deficit in the third quarter for a 34-27 win. The explosive playmaker set a Kentucky single-game freshman record with 12 receptions, good for 96 yards and a touchdown.
citations.title: Kentucky’s Kenny Darby and Lance Heard Earn SEC Weekly Honors – UK Athletics

excerpts:
* WR **Kenny Darby** caught eight passes for 110 yards.
  
    + It is Darby’s first career 100-yard receiving game and first by a UK freshman since teammate DJ Miller versus Tennessee in 2025 and only the ninth in school history.
    + He has 57 catches on the season, breaking UK freshman record of 50 by Barion Brown in 2022.
citations.title: Kentucky-Missouri Postgame Notes – UK Athletics
